欧德.who: 人族，日轮的头一位王，几千年守着金冕城东门的火，人家叫他王他不应，叫老守火的才应。月银纪3000年十一个王戴那顶没有座的金冠都低了头，戴到他头上他抬起了头，日冕之王的名字从那一刻来。

at.text: 那一夜他没有在穹都，照旧在金冕城的废墟里，守着东门的那堆火。
赤原之后皇帝把都城立在金冕城的废墟上，名叫金鸢城，东门一砖未动。欧德仍蹲在火边添柴，没有下山。
他仍守着金鸢城东门的火。接火的人说火自灰桥，传于你手，接的人应天亮以后，夜夜不熄，他蹲在旁边听，应得对，点一下头。
2988年春皇帝交了冠往南去，金鸢城东门那堆火还是他守着，他蹲在火边添柴。
他仍在东门的火边添柴，这几千年里一步也没有出过东门。
4601年初雪月，皇帝北归，摘冠擦过一回以后，有一夜去东门的火边坐到天亮。守火的欧德看了一眼他的头，头是抬着的，添了一根柴。
他照旧守着金鸢城东门的火，蹲在火边添柴，不出东门。
9318年秋塌墙的消息传到金鸢城，他头一回出了东门。走以前他把火交给守火的人，从火里捧起一捧，两只手拢着往南走，逃难的人往北，他往南，路边有人借他手里的火点起一堆。

欧德.note: who：铁狼 2306 行（月银纪3000年凝名）、月银纪史诗第十五歌。at：灰1255 行传奇表（照旧在东门火边）；白石 133、147 行（金鸢城、东门一砖未动）；灯 105 行；炮 986、1042 行（2988年春不出城）；浮塔 178 行（北归道收束，4602年初雪月）；铁狼 2309、2310 行（接火的老规矩、9318年出东门）。铁狼 2309 行写的“九千三百年浮空塔升起又落下”跟第六页总纲浮空塔8800年落尽对不上，没用。第14张那一段里的“皇帝”源稿写的是北归的那位皇帝，没点名，这里也没点。

卡尔戈·玄鳞.who: 龙裔，天脊玄鳞氏，身上的鳞掉了一半，守天脊山口的插鳞石。月银纪3850年他一个人走进几百年没人进去的逆鳞谷，三天后出来，鳞掉了一半，说从今往后是不是龙裔，我们自己说了算，鳞誓之祖的名字从那一刻来。

at.text: 天脊关着门，他照旧守在山口的插鳞石前扫雪，有人来，他先看脚。
181年皇帝跟着赫拉娜走到插鳞石前，族长和老人们问他凭什么。扫雪的卡尔戈抬起头，先看了看皇帝的脚，说他是自己走上来的，族长和老人们让开了。
200年开春天脊开门，九百名龙裔和七头真龙下山，他没有跟着去，站在山口看着他们走。
他仍在山口扫雪，替他扫石记鳞的是伊格瓦尔那一家。天脊氏族这几百年里照旧出兵，近人的龙裔一批一批耗在前线。
约2100年以后天脊下来的高阶龙裔造出龙雷炮，每年往墙上送炮手。他仍在山口，逆鳞试炼一年比一年狠，他看人先看脚。
天脊照旧往墙上送人，炮手守在隔几段一门的龙雷炮后面。他还在山口的插鳞石前，看人先看脚。
9318年秋他把插鳞石前的扫帚交给扫石的人，下了天脊，在北路最后一站的驿里歇了一夜，没有钉信，往南走了。身上的鳞掉了一半，剩下的照旧不遮。

quotes: 从今往后，是不是龙裔，我们自己说了算。
卡尔戈·玄鳞.note: who：白石 1723 至 1727 行（月银纪3850年）、诸国期午祷上。at：灰1255 行；补卷_07 地点天脊与插鳞石各时段；白石 565 至 598 行（181年）与 147 行；补卷_02 国史（200年）；白石 931 至 934 行（伊格瓦尔一家扫石）；补卷_02 灯的年月、炮的年月；补卷_24（9318年下山、驿里歇一夜）；铁狼 135 行。第5张那一段的“皇帝”照源稿用皇帝一词。

席恩.who: 人族，九矛猎团的头，十七岁的脸，雪白长发，眉心一道竖着的疤，手里一根银杖，背上一杆冰矛。月银纪1350年他拿冰矛抵着眉心醒了一整夜，一矛掷进烬笛的第七个孔，独醒者的名字从那一刻来。

at.text: 他是九矛猎团的头。九矛只猎兽，不替哪一国打仗，到了纷争纪也一样。入夜他醒着，九矛的篝火边睡着的人睡得安稳。
296年长垒合龙以后他去了南段，九矛的篝火点在墙后头，火边坐着一个白头发的少年。
他在南段守夜，不出墙。南段的夜里常有梦魇一系的影子顺着烽塔脚下摸进来叫人睡，睡过去的有的就醒不过来，南段的兵说，墙后有人醒着。
2400年坠叶月，白鸢的鞍组一夜一夜往墙后九矛的篝火去坐，坐到下半夜才回鹫舍睡一个钟头。吉纳维芙问他这一仗，他含了一回拇指，只说墙守得住。
他仍在南段守夜，不出墙，守了这么多年，银杖上的规矩一条也没有改过。
4601年坠叶月，皇帝北归，夜里在南段墙后大道边的篝火旁坐下。席恩添了一根柴，说今夜这一段他醒着，把矛尖抵住眉心，火边睡着的人慢慢安稳，皇帝出营垒以后头一回睡着。
他仍在南段墙后守夜，不出墙。约7672年南七段那三天他在南段别处的墙后，8780年沙海那十天他也守在墙后。
约9520年援军从南段动身那一夜从他的火边过。约9612年白骸连着三夜突袭，头一夜开打以前他含了一回拇指，知道这三夜墙守得住，没有问自己。他每到入夜拿冰矛抵一回眉心，自己醒着，也叫那一段墙上的人醒着。

席恩.note: who：铁狼 2323、2324 行，月银纪史诗第五歌。at：第1到6张源稿没有专门记他，只用铁狼 2325 行的做派一句，写得薄；第7张用铁狼 2326 行（长垒合龙以后去南段）；灯 105 行；炮 746、751 行（2400年白鸢的天）、3354 行；浮塔 170 行（4601年北归道）、648、1721、2177 行；铁狼 456 行（援军那一夜）、2327 行（三夜）。

博尔·焦砧.who: 矮人，熔铁炉心断崖一支的焦砧家，打山铜钉，钉山道。约9106年一座崖上的段城崖缝一夜往下走一丈，他钉了三天三夜，城里人撤完崖没有塌，钉崖者的名字是撤下来的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约9106年他在崖缝里一根一根钉了三天三夜，崖上段城的人撤完，崖没有塌。9318年秋他沿着南段钉崖，钉住了三座，第四座赶到时已经塌了，到河边时背上只剩最后一袋钉。

博尔·焦砧.note: 铁狼 2411、2412、2452 行（凝名约9106年、9318年秋那几天）、135 行（到河边背上剩最后一袋钉）。

菲恩瑞丝.who: 精灵，碧穹守望者的弓手，眼睛蒙着一层白，看得见光影看不清脸，靠喊方位的人当眼睛。约9188年雾里她听着铃声一箭穿过二十里，钉进领头铁狼胸里的核，隔雾之箭的名字是那座段城的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约9188年死域边上三天不散的雾里，她在二十里外的墙上听着铃声放了一箭，钉进领头铁狼胸里的核。9318年秋墙一段一段塌，她在还立着的几段墙上听着逃难队伍里的铃，一箭一箭射退追上来的东西，射了三天三夜。

露卡·铃尾.who: 兽耳，铃尾商路领车的信使家，尾尖系铜铃，肩挎挂满小铃的长绳。约9240年一场刮了九天的黄风里，她把三百辆车从头车拴到末车，一辆没少，缚风的名字是车上的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约9240年她拿长绳把三百辆车从头车拴到末车，熬过九天黄风。9318年秋她带着铃尾的车一趟一趟进塌下去的段城接人，十二天跑了七个来回，接出四万多人。

露卡·铃尾.note: 铁狼 2522、2556 行（凝名约9240年、9318年秋十二天七个来回）。铁狼 134 行她走在往南探路的绳头那一拍没用，留给 falls 的前一刻。

瓦尔克斯.who: 半兽人，南段段城的守门人，灰绿的皮，一根獠牙断了半截，背上一道门板宽的旧疤。约9204年魔族的攻城神殿撞断了城门闩，他拿背顶着城门站了一夜，门后的山的名字是城里的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约9204年他拿背顶住城门，攻城神殿的门槌撞了一夜，天亮时背上的皮跟铁钉长在一起，城里的人一枚一枚起出来，那根撞断的门闩送给了他。9318年秋一截墙塌下来压住一条街，他拿背顶起，顶到街上三百多个孩子和老人爬完。

萨鲁斯.who: 魔族轰狱系的牛魔，拆墙者拜恩座下砌墙也拆墙的人。约9020年一座段城的门刻满封印字，冲车撞七天撞不开，他一锤砸在门楣正中那块石头上，城门连着门楼落下，开城者的名字是跟他冲进去的轰狱先叫开的。

at.text: 9318年秋祂走过的地方营墙一圈圈散掉，他把散了营的几万轰狱领到祂没走过的山口，一夜砌起一圈墙。霜降月头一天夜里他一个人空手走到墙这一边，报了自己的名字，说祂每一回显相身上哪一处是实的，他看得出来。

萨鲁斯.note: 铁狼 2631 至 2632 行（凝名约9020年）、2627 行（9318年秋那一夜砌墙）、137 行（霜降月头一天夜里走过来）。

克萨韦尔·库尔茨.who: 人族老兵，南边靠死域的小城邦出身，十六岁上长垒南段。10743年起专进正在破的城，挨家问，挨家记，10760年第七座城破的那一夜他站在城门洞里，全城的人从他身后走完，身后无数的名字是那一城出去的人先叫开的。

at.text: 10743年起他专进正在破的城，挨家问，挨家记，城破那一夜最后一个走。10760年第七座城破的那一夜，他一个人站在城门洞里，城里的人从他身后一家一家走完，追上来的东西一样也没有越过他。

quotes: 哪一天？几袋？你自己家留了几天的？
克萨韦尔·库尔茨.note: 补卷_38 人物克萨韦尔·库尔茨第58到66行。

falls.how: 他没有拿刀，把守了几千年的火从东门捧到南段，按进了拜恩的胸口，两只手没有松开。那一刻往北逃的人回头，看见南边亮了一下，比正午的日头还亮。
falls.name: 捧火
falls.light: the blinding ember gold of the handful of fire in the foreground lighting his face from below, against a cold blue-grey dusk sky with a last copper band behind the giant's shoulder
falls.camera: high angle from the giant's own chest height looking steeply down at the old man, a little tilted, the fire filling the near foreground
falls.text: Scene: late afternoon turning to dusk beside a wide river on a grey-green plain, the autumn light going copper at the edge of the sky. The great dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into drifting grey dust, left horn already snapped off to a jagged stump, right eye a black empty socket, one thick short ridged horn still standing on the right, black light seeping down from an old wound in its left shoulder, has dropped to one knee in a flooded crater, and its enormous stone chest now hangs just above a slope of broken rubble, filling the top half of the frame. In the lower centre, small against the stone, stands old Ode, seen from the front and from above, as if the camera hung at the giant's chest. He is a spare, bent man of sixty-five with thick untidy white hair that looks dusted with ash, deep-set eyes the dark red of banked coals, a patched old leather cloak, his back bowed and his neck held straight, with no blade anywhere on him. His weathered, soot-blackened hands are cupped together and pressed against a gap in the giant's chest, and in them burns a handful of living fire, gold and ember red, so bright that it throws his shadow long behind him down the rubble and runs along every crack of the stone in veins of light. He looks up steadily into it. Far behind him, tiny, a line of refugees on a road beside the river has turned around to look back at the glow, and the small campfires along their road flare up higher. Drifting ash, sparks and grey dust blow large and out of focus across all four corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 150、2310 行：欧德把火按进祂的胸口，两只手没有松开，北逃的人回头看见南边亮了一下，路边借过火的几堆也往上蹿了一截。祂此前已被撞断左角、缠住脚踝、钉进膝骨、钉穿右眼，膝盖砸出大坑（147 行），所以画成祂跪着一膝、胸口够得到，这一处是我读出来的，源稿没写他怎么够到胸口。

falls.how: 天亮时灰里的拜恩低下头，左角冲着桥顶过去，他迎着左边那一只撞上去，灰里炸开一圈风，河边的芦苇一齐倒平。他以掉了一半鳞的身躯撞断了祂的左角，断角砸出一道沟。
falls.name: 半鳞
falls.light: low cold gold sunrise from the left behind the giant's head, the grey dust glowing at its edges against deep blue-grey shadows on the plain
falls.camera: wide, at chest height, side-on from the left with the impact at the centre and the horizon tilted a few degrees
falls.text: Scene: just after sunrise on the south bank of a wide river on a grey-green plain, reeds along the water, a stone bridge crossing the river far to the left with tiny figures crowded on it. The great dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into grey dust, black light seeping from an old wound in its left shoulder, bends its head low and drives its left horn, thick, short, blunt and ridged like broken stone, toward the bridge; only its head and shoulder fill the right half of the frame, the rest lost in dust. In the left centre, in side profile, the dragonkin Kargo hurls himself body-first into the horn at a dead run, shoulder leading, both feet just off the ground: a tall thin man of forty-nine, short blue-black hair, amber vertical pupils fixed on the stone, half of his dark blue-green scales gone and the rest scattered thin along his neck and forearms, a pale scar under his throat, a plain long wool travelling coat flying open behind him, no weapon in his hands. A white line of fractures has just run across the base of the horn and its tip is beginning to fly off. A ring of wind bursts outward from the impact and the whole reed bed around them lies flat in a perfect circle. Ash drifts across the foreground, and a few torn grey-blue scales spin out large and blurred in the near corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 141、144 行：天亮时灰里显出祂的样子，卡尔戈迎着左边那一只撞上去，芦苇一齐倒平，撞断了祂的左角。他是第一个出手的人，所以画面里祂左角还在、右眼还好。衣服写的是立绘里的长外套，没有写别的。

falls.how: 白骸连着三夜突袭长垒南段，钟一拍一波三夜不停。他每到入夜拿冰矛抵一回眉心，自己醒着，也叫那一段墙上的人醒着。第三夜快天亮时卡尔泽因走上了他守的那一段，他倒下了，墙守住了，冰矛留在垛口石缝里。
falls.name: 抵眉
falls.light: a faint cold blue night with no stars, the white frost on the spear tip glowing pale from within and lighting his face from below, a small warm campfire glow from below the wall on the left touching the soldiers' chins
falls.camera: eye level, three-quarter from the front a few paces away, slightly tilted, the line of soldiers receding behind him along the wall
falls.text: Scene: the second night of a long siege, deep night on the top of a stone wall in the south of the long wall, a low wind running across the stones. In the centre, seen from the front at three-quarter, stands the white-haired Xien, a slender youth of seventeen who is in fact thousands of years old: long snow-white hair tied at the nape with a leather cord, lake grey-blue eyes that look steady and far older than his face, a small teardrop mole under the right eye and a thin old vertical scar standing between the brows. He wears a pale grey-blue long hooded travelling coat that covers him from neck to ankle, with a leather belt. He holds a long white-wood spear in both hands with its head turned toward himself and rests the flat of its frost-white tip lightly against the middle of his own brow, the calm gesture of a night vigil that leaves no mark, the frost on the blade not melting, his eyes wide open and unwavering. Beside him on the parapet leans a plain silver walking staff with a smooth rounded knob head, its shaft carved with rows of small script. Along the wall behind him, in a line receding into the dark, soldiers in iron helmets stand on their feet with their eyes held open, some gripping their own wrists, some pinching their cheeks, a few leaning on the stone to stay awake. Far beyond the wall a flat dark plain under a sky without stars shows a distant fringe of pale tents. Thin pale frost glitters on the spear and a few drifting white flakes of dust and ash blow large and out of focus through the corners.
falls.note: 资料标着 minor、teen，所以不画倒下和血：画第三夜以前他拿冰矛抵眉心、墙上的人跟着醒着的那个完好的瞬间（源稿铁狼 2327 行，这一夜写成第二夜）。竖着的疤是他一直有的记号。帐篷那一圈远景是我补的，源稿只写墙外白骸的营。

falls.how: 他把背上最后一根山铜钉抵在祂的膝骨上，抡起焦砧家那柄锤一锤一锤钉进去，锤柄断了，钉还在。祂一条腿跪下来，膝盖砸出一个大坑，河水漫了进去。他没有回来。
falls.name: 断柄
falls.light: hard pale noon light from above and behind, sparks of gold from the nail head, the stone knee a cold grey, the long dark shadow of the giant falling across the crater
falls.camera: high angle over the dwarf's shoulder, looking steeply down at the knee, slightly tilted
falls.text: Scene: noon on the south bank of a wide river, a grey-green plain with the long wall running far behind and a flooded crater forming at the giant's feet. Seen from behind and above, over the shoulder of the dwarf Bor, the camera looks down at a huge grey stone knee: the dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into dust, left horn snapped off, black light seeping from its left shoulder, has been dragged down to one knee, and a taut rope hung with small brass bells is still wound around its left ankle at the left edge of the frame. In the lower foreground Bor, a very short, very broad dwarf of a hundred and ninety, a brown-red beard plaited in two strands whose tips are threaded through small bronze nails, small stone-blue eyes, forearms as thick as another man's calves and speckled with tiny white burn dots, a soot-brown leather smith's coat, an empty leather pouch hanging at his back, stands braced on the rubble with his feet wide. Both hands drive a white-oak hammer down on the head of a single long bronze-gold mountain nail set against the giant's kneecap. At the instant of the blow the hammer haft has snapped halfway, splinters of pale wood flying, the nail's head already flush with the stone and a web of fine light cracks spreading outward across the whole knee. Muddy river water pours into the crater below. Far away on the left, tiny, a row of people are crossing a stone bridge. Flecks of stone dust, wood splinters and sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 147、2452 行：把背上最后一根山铜钉抵在祂的膝骨上，一锤一锤钉进去，锤柄断了，钉还在，祂一条腿跪下来，膝盖砸出大坑，河水漫进去。画的是锤柄断的那一下。钉的长度是我写的。

falls.how: 萨鲁斯喊右眼，她看不清灰里，也用不着看，听着那一声，一箭钉穿了祂的右眼。那是一个她头一回听见的嗓子，粗，低，不慌，她听了一声就信了。她没有回来。
falls.name: 应声
falls.light: warm thin afternoon gold from the right on her face and bow, the far giant a cold blue-grey haze
falls.camera: mid height, a few paces to her right, a long telephoto compressing the distance between her bow and the giant's face, slightly tilted
falls.text: Scene: mid-afternoon with a thin gold light, on the broken top of a section of wall beside the river, blocks of fallen stone around her feet and dust hanging in the air. In the right third of the frame, in profile and facing left, stands the elf archer Fenruis, five hundred years old and looking in her twenties, tall, slim, long-limbed, straight in the back, long honey-gold hair in a single braid coiled at the back of her head, long pointed ears, a watcher grey-green hooded travelling coat to the ankle. Both her eyes are clouded over with a milky, semi-opaque white film that nearly hides the pupils, like eyes seen through frost, and her gaze is turned slightly to the side, listening, not focused on anything. She holds a long white fir-wood bow at full draw, the string at her ear, the first two fingers of her drawing hand thick-jointed; the arrow has just left the string and shows as a thin bright streak across the frame. At the far left of the frame, a long way off and rendered in blue-grey haze, the dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into dust, kneeling in a flooded crater with one horn snapped off and black light seeping from its left shoulder, has its huge face turned toward the right of the frame where she stands; the arrow is about to strike its right eye, a single dark point at the tip of the streak. Drifting dust and a few sparks blow large and out of focus in the corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 149、2507 行：萨鲁斯喊右眼，她听着那一声一箭钉穿了祂的右眼，喊的是她头一回听见的嗓子。她在河边墙上的哪一处，源稿没写，这里画成断墙头。

falls.how: 祂往前迈的时候，她把铃尾的长绳在祂的左脚踝上缠了几道，打了结，自己攥着结下头那一截，脚跟抵进碎石里，把血烧了起来。绳上的铃一直响，祂这一步没有迈出去。点起来的血，她再也收不回来了。
falls.name: 铃响
falls.light: flat hard late-morning light from the upper right through the dust, brass glints on the bells, deep shadow under the giant's foot
falls.camera: very low at the level of her heels, looking along the length of the rope toward the giant's foot, strong perspective
falls.text: Scene: late morning on the south bank of a wide river, broken rubble and torn grass, the air thick with grey dust. A heavy rope runs from right to left across the whole frame, drawn as taut as a bowstring and hung every arm's length with small brass bells that blur as they ring. Its left end is wound several turns around the left ankle of the dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into dust, left horn snapped off, black light seeping from its left shoulder; only the foot and shin fill the left of the frame, one huge foot lifted mid-step and stopped dead by the rope. At the right of the frame, small and low, in profile, stands the fox-eared beastkin Luka, thirty, small, sturdy and long-legged, very short cropped white-gold hair, upright fox ears of the same pale gold laid flat back, a full tail with a small brass bell at its tip lashing out behind her, in dusty grey leather and a rope-brown scarf. She grips the rope end with both hands, the knot between her fists, boot heels dug into the rubble in two long furrows, her whole body leaning back, the veins on her neck and the backs of her hands dark and swollen, the skin of her palms torn raw where the rope runs through, mouth open in a shout. Behind her to the right a line of small figures hangs on the same rope one behind another, all pitched backward, trailing away into the dust. Dust, grit and torn grass blow large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 146、2562 行：缠左脚踝，打结，脚跟抵进碎石，烧血，绳尾几十个铃尾的人一个拴一个，祂这一步没有迈出去。绳尾最后一个是乌苏，画面里没点出来。

falls.how: 祂抬起一只拳头砸下来，拳底下站着另外几个人，他迎上去，转过身，拿背扛住了那一拳，脚底下的碎石陷下去齐膝，拳底下的人都还站着。他问了一句后头还有几个，没有人答他，他再没有直起来。
falls.name: 背扛
falls.light: cold pale noon light blocked by the fist, a thin line of silver along the edge of the fist and along his shoulders and arms, and a soft pale light thrown up from the dusty ground onto his face and chest
falls.camera: very low, from among the people he shelters, looking up at his bowed chest and face, the underside of the fist filling the top of the frame, strong foreshortening
falls.text: Scene: just past noon on the south bank of a wide river, pale grey dust in the air, rubble underfoot. A boulder-like fist of grey-brown quarry stone, as large as a house, its edges dissolving into drifting grey dust, comes down from above and fills the entire top third of the frame; only the underside of the fist and a part of the wrist are visible, the wrist rising out of the top edge of the picture. It is the fist of a hill-tall stone giant whose body is entirely outside the frame: no other part of the giant is shown anywhere, there is no second figure, no head and no horn in the distance, and the far background is only the river plain, a low stone bridge, dust and a pale hazy sky. Directly beneath the fist the half-orc Valkes stands facing the camera, seen from the front and from low down, bowed forward under the stone the way a man carries a roof beam across his shoulders: about two metres twenty, grey-green skin, short dark hair, shoulders as wide as half a gate, a heavy dark leather coat. His knees are bent and wide apart, his chest is toward us, and his broad back and the back of his shoulders are pressed up against the underside of the fist, which lies across them behind and above his lowered head; he carries its whole weight there. He does not touch the stone with his hands: his two arms are spread out low, one to each side, with the hands open, sheltering the people at his feet. The crushed gravel at his feet has sunk in to his knees and the ground cracks outward in rings. A broken iron door bar longer than a man stands planted upright in the rubble beside him. He looks down at the people right in front of him, toward the camera, with his mouth open as if asking them something; one of his lower tusks is a broken stub. In the near foreground along the bottom of the frame, seen from behind and partly out of focus, are the heads and shoulders of five or six people who stand close under him, still on their feet, their faces unseen and turned up toward him: iron helmets, a hood, a bandaged head; soldiers and grown-up refugees, all of them adults. Chips of stone and dust fall large and out of focus across the foreground corners.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 148、2617 行：祂一拳砸下来，拳底下站着另外几个，他迎上去，转过身，拿背扛住，碎石陷下去齐膝，拳底下的人都还站着，他问了一句后头还有几个。拳底下的几个人是谁源稿没写，画成无名的兵和难民。（主会话第二回：只画拳和腕，不挂祂的参考图，写明远处没有别的巨人；拳落在背上；拳底下都是大人。）（11-13 人体那一轮：头偏在一侧肩上、腰带落在两肩当中，看不出是胸还是背。改成从拳底下的人堆里往上看，他正面弓着身、背顶着石头。）

falls.how: 他一处一处喊出祂身上哪里是实的，左角，左脚踝，膝，拳，右眼，嗓子一声比一声哑，喊到最后一声，胸口。欧德捧着火走上去。他喊完这一声，再没有喊。
falls.name: 墙心
falls.light: dying copper dusk light from behind the giant rimming his horns and shoulders, a faint warm gold glow from the far chest on the left side of his face, deep bronze shadows
falls.camera: close, slightly below eye level, three-quarter from the front with his outstretched arm pointing past the lens axis, shallow depth of field
falls.text: Scene: dusk on the south bank of a wide river, the last copper light behind a bank of grey dust. In the foreground, close and slightly below the camera, in three-quarter view, stands the bull-horned demon-kin Salus, nine hundred years old and looking in his forties, taller than a doorway, immensely broad and heavy-boned, deep bronze-coloured skin, a pair of thick horns growing out sideways with an iron ring bound around the left horn tip, a broad face with an old crack-shaped scar across the bridge of his nose, huge hands whose knuckles are packed with grey mortar, a plain dark brick-red work coat; a long-handled mason's hammer with one flat head and one pointed head hangs on his back and his hands are empty. His right arm is flung out straight toward the giant and his mouth is wide open, his throat swollen and the cords of his neck standing out, a hoarse shout in mid-breath, his heavy-lidded eyes not on us but fixed hard on a point in the distance. In the blurred distance past his outstretched hand, the dust giant, a demon god of walls, hill-tall, with grey-brown quarry-stone skin and edges dissolving into dust, kneels in a flooded crater with its left horn snapped off and its right eye a black empty socket, black light seeping from its left shoulder; on its chest is a dark patch with a faint pinprick of gold fire just beginning to climb toward it, carried by one tiny stooped figure at the foot of the stone. The corners are filled with drifting ash and grit, large and out of focus.
falls.note: 源稿铁狼 150 行：天快黑的时候萨鲁斯的嗓子一声比一声哑，喊到最后一声胸口，欧德捧着火走上去。祂的状态按那几声的先后写（左角、右眼已毁，膝已跪）。远处那个小小的人是欧德。

falls.how: 第十一座城破的那一夜，他把三十一年的稿子装进一只山铜扁匣，交给往外走的最后一队人，自己留在门口。有人问他不走吗，他说他走了这匣子谁来保，门口有个人和门口没人，不一样。
falls.name: 扁匣
falls.light: the red-orange glow of the burning city behind him through the arch, rimming the old man's grey hair and shoulders, cool blue night shadow on the road in front
falls.camera: low and a little to one side, outside the gate looking back through the arch toward the old man, slightly tilted
falls.text: Scene: night at the north gate of a walled city that is falling, seen from outside the gate looking back in. The tall stone gate arch fills the centre of the frame, its doors broken open, the red-orange fire of burning roofs glowing through it and thick smoke rolling above. In the middle of the arch stands the old soldier Xaver Kurtz, a short broad man of about seventy who looks fifty, with cropped grey-white hair, very pale blue eyes, a long scar running down the right forearm from wrist to elbow, a battered old wall-guard's cloak, the fingers of his right hand curled and unable to straighten. He is seen from the front, standing square in the gateway and empty-handed, his curled right hand still held out at chest height where he has just let go of something; his face is calm and steady and his eyes follow the people leaving. Streaming out past him on both sides and coming toward the camera is the last file of townsfolk: women, an old man leaning on a stick, a boy carrying a smaller child on his back. At the front of the file, a man in the left foreground carries a flat, worn bronze box about a foot square, its edges rubbed round and its latch wired shut with a twist of iron, held tight against his chest in both arms. Behind the old soldier the gate light throws long shadows across the road toward us. Ash, sparks and smoke flakes drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 补卷_38 第65、69 行：山铜扁匣，一尺见方，边角磨圆，锁扣拿铁丝拧上，他把三十一年的稿子装进去交给往外走的最后一队人，自己留在门口。城门的方向、人流往哪边走、城破是什么样都是我定的，源稿只写“门口”，没有写追上来的是什么，画面里没有画那个东西。

notes: 席恩第1到6张源稿没有专门记他，只用了做派里的一句，那一段写得很薄，要不要并进第7张的说法再定。
席恩的陨落按未成年的规矩画成第三夜以前（写作第二夜）抵眉心的完好瞬间，how 里写了他倒下，画面里没有。
欧德第15、16张没有用铁狼 2309 行“九千三百年浮空塔升起又落下”那一句，它跟第六页总纲里浮塔8800年落尽对不上。
七幅陨落里拜恩的状态是照喊的次序排的：左角（卡尔戈）、左脚踝（露卡）、膝（博尔）、拳（瓦尔克斯）、右眼（菲恩瑞丝）、胸口（欧德），每一幅里祂毁到哪一步按这个写，次序要是改了，七幅要一起改。
七幅的 beast 都挂 strife_god1_015_1（灰里的巨人），015_2 有带翼的半石神，015_3 有白马，9318年没有它们，没挂。
欧德怎么够到祂的胸口，源稿没写，我读成祂跪下一膝（147 行）以后胸口落到碎石坡上方。
克萨韦尔那一幅的城门方向和城的样子是我定的（北门，人往北出来），源稿只写“门口”。
菲恩瑞丝站在河边断墙头是我补的，源稿只写她射了那一箭。
卡尔戈的 who 用了 casual（立绘里的长外套），战斗格没有看。
欧德 casual 那一套是补过的旧皮斗篷，对得上源稿，没有武器，符合他一辈子没拿过刀。
